title: CDC Lyme disease reported cases by year, 2008-2021 (national totals)
unit: reported cases (national sum of aggregate cells)
definition: Confirmed and probable cases under the 2008-2021 definition.
method: Sum of the frequency column over all aggregate rows, by year and case status (matches the row counts of the no-geography line list).
comparability: A reported surveillance case is not the same denominator as a diagnosed-and-treated insurance episode; claims-based studies commonly estimate several times more.
Do not combine eras: the surveillance definition changed in 2022 (most cases are then classed "Probable"), so compare confirmed-plus-probable totals, not confirmed alone.
summary: 2008-2021: annual reported cases (confirmed plus probable) range 18,000 to 42,743; confirmed alone 12,123 to 29,959.
how_to_use: Cross-check the document's national case count or incidence for the same year, and state whether the two are on the same definition.

provenance.collection_note: Case reports submitted by state health departments; passive reporting, so counts are a subset of true cases.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: A reported surveillance case is not the same denominator as a diagnosed-and-treated insurance episode; claims-based studies commonly estimate several times more.
provenance.reliability: Counts, not estimates; subject to under-reporting and to the 2022 definition change.
